runtime.scope: Read-only local fixtures. Network disabled. Raster comparisons use full raw bands, not checksums or rendered colors. Vector results establish opening only.

scope: Full width, height, band count, GDAL datatype and SHA-256 of every raw pixel in band-sequential little-endian order. No georeferencing/mask/overview/vector equivalence claim.

samples.reason: The fixture declares SampleFormat=2 and BitsPerSample=24. Pinned GDAL GTiffOddBitsBand explicitly maps signed 17-31-bit integer widths to UInt32; its constructor contains a FIXME naming int24.tif. Hexplain preserves the signed Int32 interpretation. Existing fixture pixel bits match; separate negative-boundary tests exercise sign extension. This is an explained datatype difference, not an interoperability pass.
